notes:
Add chapter 12 "Buses & displays" with 16 levels

From the first lit digit through decoders, a ROM as lookup table, the
bus tool, a running light, a dot matrix driven row by row (the player
makes the SCAN chip) and pictures from bytes, to text on an LCD and a
counter display 0-9. Each level has a three-star model solution whose
wires the router lays, as in the game. Checks read display pins
(SEG1.a), LCD text and the matrix picture.

Found on the way: a bus narrowing from both sides needs its outer
wires first (new order outside-in); WR/CLR of the LCD move below the
data pins so they stay reachable after a data bus; a WR already high
at the start of a simulation no longer writes an empty character.
